Data.Definition: Maternal mortality rate for the seven years preceding the survey expressed per 1,000 women-years of exposure. Maternal deaths are deaths to adult females during pregnancy, delivery or in the 42 days following delivery, excluding those due to accidents or violence.

Data.Label: General fertility rate
Data.Definition: General fertility rate for the seven years preceding the survey per 1,000 women age 15-49

Data.Label: Pregnancy-related mortality ratio
Data.Definition: Pregnancy-related mortality ratio for the seven years preceding the survey expressed per 100,000 live births, calculated as the age-adjusted pregnancy-related mortality rate times 100 divided by the age-adjusted general fertility rate. Pregnancy-related deaths are deaths during pregnancy, delivery and in the two months following delivery, including deaths due to accidents or violence

Data.Label: Pregnancy-related mortality ratio CI lower bound (PRMR-2SE)
Data.Definition: Lower bound for the confidence interval of the pregnancy-related mortality ratio calculated as the pregnancy-related mortality ratio minus 2 standard errors
Data.ShortName: Pregnancy-related mortality ratio CI lower bound (MMR-2SE)

Data.Label: Pregnancy-related mortality ratio CI upper bound (PRMR+2SE)
Data.Definition: Upper bound for the confidence interval of the pregnancy-related mortality ratio calculated as the pregnancy-related mortality ratio plus 2 standard errors
Data.ShortName: Pregnancy-related mortality ratio CI upper bound (MMR+2SE)

Data.Label: Lifetime risk of pregnancy-related death
Data.Definition: Lifetime risk of pregnancy-related death calculated as 1-(1-PRMR)^TFR where TFR is the total fertility rate for the seven years preceding the survey. Pregnancy-related deaths are deaths during pregnancy, delivery and in the two months following delivery, including deaths due to accidents or violence

Data.Label: Maternal mortality ratio
Data.Definition: Maternal mortality ratio for the seven years preceding the survey expressed per 100,000 live births, calculated as the age-adjusted maternal mortality rate times 100 divided by the age-adjusted general fertility rate. Maternal deaths are deaths to adult females during pregnancy, delivery or in the 42 days following delivery, excluding those due to accidents or violence.

Data.Label: Maternal mortality ratio CI lower bound (MMR-2SE)
Data.Definition: Lower bound for the confidence interval of the maternal mortality ratio calculated as the maternal mortality ratio minus 2 standard errors
Data.ShortName: Maternal mortality ratio CI lower bound (MMR-2SE)

Data.Label: Maternal mortality ratio CI upper bound (MMR+2SE)
Data.Definition: Upper bound for the confidence interval of the maternal mortality ratio calculated as the maternal mortality ratio plus 2 standard errors
Data.ShortName: Maternal mortality ratio CI upper bound (MMR+2SE)

Data.Label: Lifetime risk of maternal death
Data.Definition: Lifetime risk of maternal death calculated as 1-(1-MMR)^TFR where TFR is the total fertility rate for the seven years preceding the survey.
